title: Evaluation of the explicit additive scalar Hom map
statement: For Λ commutative, k:W→S, G a module sheaf, q a natural degree, U etale over S, A over W and a module raw class z on A, the scalar raw map equals scalarSourceFactor followed by derived forgetting of z followed by scalarCoefficientFactor.

source.place: Tags 03FD and 03Q8; explicit raw-map formula expansion

proof.text: Expand the definition of rawModuleAbelianHomMap. Its additive map is the composite of derived forgetting, right composition by the coefficient factor, and left composition by the source factor. Evaluation of AddCommGrpCat.ofHom and of the two additive compositions therefore gives c composed with V(z) composed with b. The two named factor definitions have exactly these source and coefficient bodies. No naturality or coherence equation is used. This applies to zero classes, zero sheaves, identity geometric maps and degree zero.

lean.statement:
theorem rawModuleScalar_map_formula
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S)
    (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℕ) (U : S.Etale)
    (A : Over W)
    (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverFunctor Λ k G (q : ℤ) U).obj (op A)) :
    rawModuleAbelianHomMap Λ k G q U A z =
      scalarSourceFactor Λ (A.hom ≫ k) ((freeSheaf Λ S).obj U)
        (RawModuleScalarComparison.freeAbelian S U)
        (RawModuleScalarComparison.freeMap Λ S U) ≫
      (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ A.left).mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map z ≫
        scalarCoefficientFactor Λ A.hom G (q : ℤ)
